events.event: Topic 5.4 Costs authored from scratch under standard v0.2.0-draft - all 31 checks pass first time
events.note: The first topic written under the rules rather than repaired into them. 59 claims, 4 content units (5,340 words), 88 learning items (84 flashcards + 4 performance tasks), 5,422-word rendered notes. Every artefact carries claims_seen and authored_hash from creation, so RS-41 is satisfied by construction. Three lessons from the 5.2 reviews were applied BEFORE authoring: the contract's required_outputs corrected from an objective count to a content-unit count, twelve excluded constructs recorded so the suite could enforce scope from the first draft, and the registry's command words reconciled against observed paper demand (six objectives gained a command word the evidence already showed). RS-08: 'contribution' finally has a canonical definition and a documented contextual variation. C-18 was corrected during the build - it was testing AO4 by item count, which the framework's own rule forbids.

events.event: Topic 5.4 review round 1 returned reject (2 critical, 6 high, 5 medium); repaired; 33 of 35 checks pass
events.note: The measurement: authoring under v0.2.0 gave 8 blocking issues against 5.2's 13, a 38% reduction. Every defect class the rules target was absent; what remained was subject-matter accuracy - a collapsed cost classification, owner's drawings as a fixed cost, an invalid 'assumptions cancel' claim, a wrong indifference volume. Conclusion recorded: review is a permanent per-topic cost, not a gate the framework outgrows. Four checks built from the findings (C-31 modality coverage, C-32 arithmetic verification, C-33 self-containment, C-34 interpretation vs check), each verified to reproduce its finding before repair. C-30 rebuilt - its first design could never fire. 15 evidence records re-mapped after the homonym false positives; the rest of the corpus is now flagged as token-matched and unvalidated. Items 88->91.

events.event: Topic 5.4 review round 2: 1 critical, 1 high, 3 medium, 2 low; repaired; 34 of 36 checks pass
